research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mythical Games is researching systems and methods for multi currency utilities in an online game, transfer of rights pertaining to game assets between users, and determining authenticity of non fungible digital assets. They develop systems and methods for operating a bridge server to support multiple shards of blockchains, enabling exchange of tradeable items, and synchronizing database operations with a distributed blockchain. Their work focuses on digital asset ownership, trading, and cross platform game economies.

overview_description.description: Mythical Games develops and publishes blockchain-enhanced video games, focusing on providing players with true ownership of in-game assets. The company offers the Mythical Platform, a comprehensive solution that helps developers integrate a secondary economy into their games. The platform uses the MYTH token and the Mythos Chain to facilitate secure transactions within the digital ecosystem.

about_short_description.short_description: Mythical Games develops video games and a platform enabling true ownership of in-game items.

product.name: Mythical Platform
product.description: A platform for game developers and publishers to add secondary economies, player-owned digital assets, and marketplace functionality to their games through REST APIs and SDKs.

product.name: FIFA Rivals
product.description: A free-to-play mobile arcade football game for iOS and Android featuring fast-paced matches and tradable, player-owned game assets.

product.name: Blankos
product.description: An arcade game featuring collectible characters and game items, with ownership and trading supported through Mythical’s digital-asset ecosystem.

product.name: Pudgy Party
product.description: A mobile multiplayer party game for iOS and Android built around penguin-themed knockout gameplay and collectible digital assets.

product.name: Mythical Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace for buying, selling, and trading NFT-based digital assets used in Mythical games and games that integrate Mythical’s platform.

product.name: Mythos
product.description: A blockchain ecosystem and MYTH token infrastructure supporting transactions, interoperability, and digital economies across Mythical’s gaming marketplace and partner ecosystem.
